setup/ghidra_seed.cpp.task: One-time Ghidra seeding (no RoR functions to write; Ghidra must have /Rule of Rose - US open). From tools/reverse: (1) python restore_names.py --snapshot (a copy of every current name). (2) python sections.py --apply: creates the ~1,412 functions at the ELF's named .gnu.linkonce.t sections plus the ~95 vtable slot targets Ghidra never found, and names the sections with RoR's own symbols (tag ror-symbol). (3) python libmatch.py --list lib-match-low (look at the hints), then python libmatch.py --apply: ~555 high and ~141 low library / runtime names from the SDK 3.0 (ReiPan's FF3) and ee-gcc 2.96 (FF2 debug) references; existing names such as Ghidra's syscalls are kept. (4) Name the game's entry with a name_ctx.py batch: 002045a8 main (ror-inferred; crt0 _start calls it after _InitSys and atexit; it prints the build date 'Jul 27 2006' '22:25:45' and the boot device, and loads ioprp300.img). (5) python refresh.py; references/status.md 'Ghidra seeding' must show no '-> run' hint; then python ghidra.py func on a few slot targets and section functions to see the bodies are sane (a body that runs past its section end means a neighbour is missing a function: mkfunc it). (6) Record the counts in architecture.md 'Naming sources', then finish --status done.

setup/platform_bootstrap.cpp.task: Create the PC project (no RoR functions to write). The platform layer comes from ReiPan (../ReiPan, read-only), which took it from MioPan (FF2) and adapted it to FF3: src/sdk emulates the PS2 SDK (libgraph, libdma, libvif, libvu0, libpad, libmc, libcdvd, sif / IOP host, libmpeg + FFmpeg, eekernel threads), src/reipan draws the GS through SDL3 GPU and holds the host thread, log, paths, config and the ImGui debug UI. Steps: (1) copy ../ReiPan/src/reipan to src/rosepan and ../ReiPan/src/sdk to src/sdk; rename ReiPan_ / REIPAN_ / reipan_ identifiers, env variables and file names to RosePan_ / ROSEPAN_ / rosepan_, keeping the tool contract in tools/reverse/README.md 'Platform contract' (ROSEPAN_SHOT_DIR / ROSEPAN_SHOT_EVERY screenshots of the presented frame, ROSEPAN_AUTOPAD scripted pad in sdk/libpad.cpp, ROSEPAN_DATA_DIR, the RosePanGame thread name, the stub log line). (2) Write src/common/rosepan_stub.h from ../ReiPan/src/common/reipan_stub.h: ROSEPAN_STUB / ROSEPAN_BRIDGE printing '[stub] Name (ROR 0x%08x) reached'. (3) Drop or neutralise FF3-only pieces and list each in open-items.md 'Platform bootstrap': reipan/debug/reipan_warp.* (FF3 chapter warps and snapshots), FF3 game hooks in rendering/reipan_graph3d.cpp and reipan_ui, FF3 file names in io/reipan_paths (IMG_BD.BIN, ZERO3.FHD: RoR reads 'cdrom0:\\DATA\\...' and data/... paths, decide the data folder layout from the ELF), the FF3 IOP services in sdk/iop_* (RoR loads only Sony modules: sio2man, padman, mcman, mcserv, cdvdman, cdvdfsv, fileio, sifcmd, usbd, plus ioprp300.img; its sound goes through rxmpeg / the rx middleware). (4) CMakeLists.txt, CMakePresets.json, cmake/*.cmake and resources/ (shaders) from ReiPan with ReiPan renamed RosePan: target RosePan, output cmake-build-*/RosePan/RosePan.exe, the sibling extern fallback pointed at ../ReiPan/extern then ../MioPan/extern (FFmpeg, shadercross), -fno-strict-aliasing and the src/sdk/pc_prefix.h force-include kept, every .c/.cpp compiled as C++. (5) A placeholder src/main.cpp whose main() initialises the platform, opens the window and presents cleared frames until RoR's main (0x002045a8) is reconstructed. (6) python build.py green; python build.py --run 15 writes work/shots/last.png (look at it); python layoutcheck.py runs clean. Keep platform edits minimal and list them in the summary; record the layer's shape in architecture.md 'PC platform layer' and anything that burned time in hazards.md. Finish --status done (the screenshot of an empty window is the expected picture).
